Vincenzo Pennacchio Description: Vincenzo Pennacchio is a Full-Stack Developer with over five years of international experience across Italy, Romania, Australia, and Spain. He has worked as a Software Developer at Tre Emme Engineering, embedded in Accenture-led teams delivering enterprise web applications for major clients including TIM and Generali. Vincenzo also gained international freelance experience in Perth, Australia, working with established brands such as CBH Group and The Good Guys. He currently works in Valencia through the Erasmus for Young Entrepreneurs programme, integrating AI-powered computer vision systems into real retail environments for clients including Mercadona. His core expertise spans Vue.js, React, PHP, and full-stack web development. Vincenzo holds a Diploma in IT and Telecommunications and has developed a strong track record of adapting quickly across industries, cultures, and technology stacks.
our_portfolio_title: 🌍 What We Do: European Projects Creating Connections, Impact, and Change
our_portfolio_intro: Senza Confini APS is not just a youth association: we are a permanent laboratory for European project design, a reference point for those who want to turn ideas into tangible impact. In recent years, we have developed, implemented, and supported innovative projects within Erasmus+, CERV, ESC, Creative Europe, Horizon Europe, LIFE, Interreg NEXT MED, and Virtual Exchange.
our_portfolio_strength: Our strength is twofold: we know the local area and its needs well, yet we also speak the language of Europe. We handle both design and management, offering professional, reliable, and tailored consulting services to third-sector organizations, public administrations, schools, and informal groups.
project_types_intro: We create customized pathways for young people, educators, local communities, and professionals, always with an inclusive, innovative, and sustainable approach.
project_examples_title: 📌 Here are some examples of the projects we’ve carried out:
project_0: 2020-EDU-02341 With the Children _ Educating Communities: Project “UMBERTIAMO: EDUCATIONAL COMMUNITY UMBERTO I” — social inclusion, active citizenship, community cooperation, creation of an educational community in the Umbertino district of La Spezia
project_1: KA210-YOU “Tech QUEENS – AI” (Erasmus+ KA2): Young people from Italy and Luxembourg engaged in an AI literacy training path through local environmental education activities and an international youth policy conference.
project_2: KA152-YOU-BA820889 & KA152-YOU-219A1096 (Erasmus+ Youth Exchanges): Youth exchanges in La Spezia and across Europe promoting active citizenship, intercultural dialogue, and sustainability, with over 60 young participants in creative, sports, and participatory pathways.
project_3: Educating Communities Umberto I (Con i Bambini – Social Enterprise): A €1.3M project that revolutionized education in a city suburb, thanks to a network between schools, families, associations, and institutions.
project_4: KA1 Mobility Projects (2024–2025): We participate in international training projects for youth workers, promoting non-formal educational methods on mental well-being, inclusion, and digital skills.
project_5: KA210-YOU-CD3C7FA9 (Erasmus+ KA2 – 2025): This project, currently starting, aims to build a Euro-Mediterranean network of young environmental activists and digital trainers.
services_intro: In addition to managing projects directly, we offer consulting and professional support for public and private entities:
cta_text: Whether you’re a municipality, school, NGO, or social enterprise, we can help you build solid, visionary, and fundable projects. Get in touch and let’s have a good chat about it!
closing_note: Senza Confini APS – European projects to transform communities. From the territory to Europe. And back again.
motto: “Building bridges across Europe, one project at a time.”
Nicollo Ichestre Description: holds a degree in Political and International Sciences from the University of Genoa. He is the president of the association 'Senza Confini APS', founded in 2020 to promote social inclusion and local development. He has gained experience as an European Project Manager, managing Erasmus+, AMIF, and CERV projects. He has completed internships in Bucharest and Brussels, honing his skills in multicultural contexts. Known for his empathy, confidence, and problem-solving orientation, his curiosity and desire for continuous improvement make him an effective leader and promoter of community development.
Edoardo Marcuzzi Description: is a young filmmaker who supports the association ‘Senza Confini APS’ in the management of social media and the digital part of events. His experience in the audiovisual and communication fields makes him a valuable collaborator for the online promotion of the association's activities and projects. Moreover, Edoardo contributes to the creation of visual and video content to raise awareness and involve the public in the social and cultural initiatives promoted by ‘Senza Confini APS’. His creative approach and digital expertise amplify the impact of the association's actions.
Costantino Landi Description: He is a Project Manager at the NGO SenzaConfini and a dedicated changemaker who believes in the transformative power of education, culture, and human connection. With over seven years of experience in Youth in Action and Erasmus+, he has contributed to more than 20 international projects that promote youth empowerment and intercultural dialogue. As a trainer and facilitator, he integrates non‑formal education, social planning, and psychosynthesis to foster skills development and self‑awareness. His journey includes a year at Rondine Cittadella della Pace, immersed in dialogue, peacebuilding, and youth engagement. Costantino has designed and led projects on social entrepreneurship, psychosynthesis, sustainability, creative arts, and gender equality, collaborating with NGOs, institutions, and grassroots stakeholders. Active in CERV, Erasmus+, ESC, and Creative Europe, he sees projects as ecosystems in which individuals become co‑creators of meaningful, targeted learning and shared growth.
Marco Maricchiolo Description: is an EU Project Manager with a strong passion for the development and management of EU-funded projects. With a strong background in international cooperation, he has acquired skills in activity planning, performance monitoring, and risk management. Marco holds a Master's degree in Europlanning, which gave him an in-depth understanding of European project management. Currently, he works for Senza Confini APS, where he is involved in the management and implementation of EU-funded projects, such as Erasmus+ and other European programs. He is motivated to contribute to the success of innovative projects that have a positive impact on European communities, working with multidisciplinary teams to develop initiatives that promote education, solidarity and innovation.
Maria Michela Giallaurito Description: is a professional with solid experience in international affairs and project management. She has worked as an EU Project Manager in Bucharest, managing key European projects such as Erasmus+, CERV and AMIF, coordinating activities with international partners and ensuring the achievement of project objectives. Michela also served as Faculty Advisor during UN conferences in New York, guiding young delegates in diplomatic simulations. Her experience also includes a specialization in leadership, with a Master's degree in Leadership for International Relations.
Andreea Enciu Description: is a creative and team-driven professional with over five years of experience in youth-focused projects across Europe. Her expertise lies in project management, intercultural collaboration, and digital communication. With over five years of experience working, she has been actively involved in the design, coordination, and implementation of international programs focused on education, social inclusion, and community development. Additional, Andreea enhances the organization's visibility and community engagement by developing strategic and authentic communication across social media platforms, showcasing the real impact of youth-driven projects.
Alice Pomodoro Description: is a sex educator and communication manager, with a specific interest for NGOs and educational organisations. She is graduating from the Master's degree in Gender Studies at Charles University (Prague), where she acquired knowledge in feminist theory, focusing in particular on post/decolonial, queer, and crip theories and approaches. Thanks to her background, she contributes to the design of projects and training courses that take into account intersectional identities and experiences, with the aim of liberating people from oppressive and discriminatory systems.

Collaborative Networking:

Cultural and Educational Programs:

Fundraising and Support Initiatives:

Closing Message Text: At Senza Confini, we are committed to creating a brighter, more inclusive future driven by the energy, passion, and creativity of young people. Join us in shaping a society where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
About Us Full Text 1: Senza Confini is a Social Promotion Association established in 2020 in La Spezia, dedicated to inspiring and empowering young people to actively shape their communities and society as a whole.
About Us Full Text 2: Operating at both local and European levels, our organization is committed to fostering active citizenship among youth while addressing critical challenges such as climate change, gender equality, democracy, and social inclusion.
About Us Full Text 3: At Senza Confini, we believe that young people are the driving force behind positive change. Through innovative projects, educational programs, and active community engagement, we support youth in becoming proactive contributors to their social, cultural, and political environments. By building connections across borders, we aim to create a stronger, more inclusive Europe.
